{"metadata":{"description":"Honcho integration for the DeepSeek Harness","id":"gh:1352680042","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-honcho","slug":"plastic-labs/dsh-honcho","topics":["deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Honcho integration for the DeepSeek Harness"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-honcho"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文 | Русский"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Persistent memory for DeepSeek Harness, powered by
Honcho."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"`dsh` forgets everything when a session ends. This plugin gives it memory that doesn't: what you're "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"building,
how you like to work, what you decided last week and why. It reads the same `~/.honcho/con"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"fig.json` as the
other Honcho integrations, so there is one place to configure all of them — and poi"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"nting two of them at the
same `workspace` gives them one shared memory."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Install"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"Then put your API key and name in `~/.honcho/config.json`:"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"Get a key at app.honcho.dev. `HONCHO_API_KEY` in the environment also works on its
own — the config "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"file is only needed to change defaults."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Injects what Honcho knows at the start of a session** — your peer card, a summary of this project'"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"s session so
far, and the conclusions Honcho has drawn that are relevant to what you just asked. One"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" API call, shaped to a
character budget, refreshed as you work."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**Captures every turn.** User and assistant messages go to Honcho in the background, debounced, and "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"flushed at
turn boundaries, before compaction, and on shutdown. Common secret formats are redacted f"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"irst (API keys and
tokens, `password:`/`secret:` fields, private keys, JWTs, cookies, connection str"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"ings, credential URLs). This is
regex matching, so it is best-effort: an unusual format, or a bare h"},{"id":"p13s5","text":"igh-entropy string with no label, can still
get through. Add your own with `capture.noisePatterns`, "},{"id":"p13s6","text":"or turn capture off with `capture.saveMessages`."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"**Gives the model three tools:**"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"| Tool              | For                                                                        |"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| `honcho_search`   | Looking something up. Searches raw messages _and_ derived conclusions.     |
|"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" `honcho_chat`     | Asking a question of judgment. Reasons over everything Honcho knows. Slow. |
| "},{"id":"p16s3","text":"`honcho_remember` | Saving a durable fact, preference, or decision.                            |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"**`/honcho`** shows status and a link to the session in the Honcho dashboard — see Commands below."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"Everything behavioral lives in `~/.honcho/config.json` under `hosts.dsh` — the same file `claude-hon"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"cho`,
`codex-honcho`, and the other integrations read. Root holds identity and connection; the host "},{"id":"p19s3","text":"block holds
behavior."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"The file is read as strict JSON: the comments and trailing commas below are annotation only. Leave t"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"hem in and
the whole file is skipped without a warning, so every setting falls back to its default."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Injection components"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The two menus differ in **cadence**, not in what they can carry."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"`injection.sessionStart` is injected once when a session opens: `directives` (guidance on using memo"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ry),
`summary`, `peerCard`, `representation`."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"`injection.perTurn` refreshes as you work:"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"- **`userContext`** — a fresh, prompt-scoped peer context blob: **representation + peer card**, retr"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"ieved using
your current message as the search query so recall is associative rather than merely rec"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ent. It is a bundle,
so it supplies both regardless of what `sessionStart` names. To get one without"},{"id":"p26s4","text":" the other, name it in
`sessionStart` and set `perTurn: []` — at the cost of per-turn refresh.
- **`"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"dialectic`** — a reasoned answer about you, run every `cadence.dialectic` turns and shaped by
`injec"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"tion.dialectic`. Nothing waits on it after the first turn, so a late answer reaches the next one."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Components the canonical schema names but this plugin does not implement — `briefing`, `assistantCon"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"text`,
`sessionContext` — are reported at startup rather than silently dropped, as are schema keys i"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"t does not act on
(`showContents`, `statusline`, `globalOverride`, granular `observation`, `multiUse"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"r`) and any key renamed since
an earlier version. Nothing here is accepted and quietly ignored."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The plugin's own `cordis.yml` config carries plumbing only — `configPath`, `apiKeyRef`, `host`, `ena"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"bled`. Set
`host` to run a credential-isolated profile (`"dsh_work"`) against the same install."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Sharing memory with other integrations"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"Each integration defaults to its own Honcho `workspace` — `dsh` here, `claude_code` for claude-honch"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"o — and a
workspace is the isolation boundary, so **by default they do not see each other's memory.*"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"* Point them at the
same `workspace` to merge them:"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Keep `peerName` identical across them too, since conclusions are stored per peer. `sessionStrategy:
"},{"id":"p32s2","text":""git-remote"` and `sessionPrefix` are proposed for claude-honcho as well, so a repo worked on from b"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"oth can be
pointed at one session on purpose rather than by accident."},{"id":"p33s1","text":"### Sessions"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Default: one long-lived session per project directory, named `<peerName>-<dir>`, matching claude-hon"},{"id":"p34s2","text":"cho. Pin a
different name for any path with the root `sessions` map — an override always wins."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| `sessionStrategy`         | Session name            | Notes                                       "},{"id":"p35s2","text":"                       |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"| `per-directory` (default) | `<peer>-<dir>`          | Stable across restarts and branches         "},{"id":"p36s2","text":"                       |
| `per-repo`                | `<peer>-<repo-root>`    | Same memory from an"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"y subdirectory                                  |
| `git-remote`              | `<peer>-<host-owner-"},{"id":"p36s4","text":"repo>` | From the `origin` URL, so the same repo on two machines is one session. Falls back to `per-"},{"id":"p36s5","text":"directory` outside a repo or without an `origin` |
| `git-branch`              | `<peer>-<dir>-<bran"},{"id":"p36s6","text":"ch>` | Falls back to `per-directory` outside a repo or on a detached HEAD |
| `per-session`         "},{"id":"p36s7","text":"    | `<peer>-chat-<id>`      | A clean slate every restart                                        |"},{"id":"p36s8","text":"
| `global`                  | `<peer>`                | One memory for everything                  "},{"id":"p36s9","text":"                        |"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"`per-directory` and `per-repo` name a session after a folder, so two different projects that both li"},{"id":"p37s2","text":"ve in a
`web` directory silently share one memory across machines. `git-remote` is the fix: it reduc"},{"id":"p37s3","text":"es the `origin` URL
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"- Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- A running `dsh`, `0.1.2-rc.1` or later (typechecked against `0.2.1-r"},{"id":"p39s2","text":"c.2`; tested on `0.1.2-rc.1` through `0.2.1-rc.4`)
- A Honcho API key, or a self-hosted Honcho at `b"},{"id":"p39s3","text":"ested on `0.1.2-rc.1` through `0.2.1-rc.4`)
- A Honcho API key, or a self-hosted Honcho at `baseUrl`"}],"truncated":true}
